title: Measure a note
prompt: Note is supplied. Its Text may be null. Write public static int TextLength(Note? note). Return the number of characters in the note's text. Return 0 when note is null, and 0 when its Text is null.
hints: How many different things can be missing here?
Both the note and its Text need a check before Length is read.
Use ?. at each step that may be null and ?? 0 at the end, or test both with if before reading Length.
checkLabels: A note with the text Pack must give 4.
A note with missing text must give 0.
A note with empty text must give 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Checks the note but not its text.
Checks the text but not the note itself.

feedback: A NullReferenceException means a member was read on null. Find which of the two values was missing in the failing case.
